say:1:1041580301:1.text: Wow! That look of yours is perfected for Ghostly Getaway!
say:1:1041580301:1.source_cn: 哇！你这个造型太适合“鬼影密室”了！

say:2:1041580302:1.text: I've got to introduce you to Madam Gerda. She should invite you to the Frozen Paw to play a ghost at the next Snowspire Festival!
say:2:1041580302:1.source_cn: 我一定要把你介绍给老板娘，让她在下次冬日祭典的时候邀请...

say:3:1041580303:1.text: Snowspire Festival? That name sounds familiar...
say:3:1041580303:1.source_cn: 冬日祭典？我好像在哪听说过这个名字……

say:4:1041580304:1.text: Ah, I remember. You mean the Snowspire Festival over in the Duchy of Whiteridge?
say:4:1041580304:1.source_cn: ……啊，想起来了。你说的是白山公国的冬日祭典吧？

say:5:1041580305:1.text: That's the one! It's held in Cedartown, in Whiteridge. We don't get anything this fun in the Dark Forest...
say:5:1041580305:1.source_cn: 是啊！就在白山公国的雪松镇上。薄暮丛林可没有这么有趣的节日。

say:6:1041580306:1.text: Come to think of it... Now that I'm looking closer, were you from the Lightbearer Empire when you were alive?
say:6:1041580306:1.source_cn: 这样说来，仔细一看……你生前是耀光人？

say:7:1041580307:1.text: Born and raised a Lightbearer! Although these days, I suppose I'm more of a Lightbearer ghost.
say:7:1041580307:1.source_cn: 对，我是耀光人，不过现在应该算是耀光的鬼了。

say:8:1041580308:1.text: It's a shame my home was right on the border and constantly in turmoil. Never really got the chance to travel, either. So, nope, never made it to Whiteridge.
say:8:1041580308:1.source_cn: 可惜我的家乡地处边境，一直动荡不安，我没有太多机会远行...

say:9:1041580309:1.text: Then you definitely need to go! Honestly, I think it's the friendliest place in the whole empire for the Graveborn—uh, not that other Lightbearers are hostile to you guys!
say:9:1041580309:1.source_cn: 那你真的应该去看看！我觉得那里应该是耀光帝国对亡灵最友...

say:10:1041580310:1.text: Haha, don't worry, I know what you mean.
say:10:1041580310:1.source_cn: 哈哈，不用这么紧张，我明白你的意思。

say:11:1041580311:1.text: And honestly, a lot of humans really are hostile toward the Graveborn. My family and friends and I used to be the same way.
say:11:1041580311:1.source_cn: 而且很多耀光人确实很敌视亡灵，这是事实。我和我的家人朋...

say:12:1041580312:1.text: If we hadn't gone to Bantus ourselves, we might never have changed our minds.
say:12:1041580312:1.source_cn: 要不是亲自去了一趟班题斯，可能我们的想法永远都不会改变。

say:14:1041580314:1.text: Yeah. That's where I was turned into a Graveborn. Terrible vacation spot, by the way. Wouldn't recommend it.
say:14:1041580314:1.source_cn: 是啊，我就是在那里被转化成亡灵的。

say:15:1041580315:1.source_cn: 转化？！这听起来可不太妙……

say:16:1041580316:1.text: It was. Neither dying nor having your soul torn apart is exactly pleasant.
say:16:1041580316:1.source_cn: 是啊，无论是肉体死亡还是灵魂被撕裂的感受，都不太好。

say:17:1041580317:1.text: But enough of that. Let's talk about something more fun!
say:17:1041580317:1.source_cn: 好了，别说这些了，还是来聊些高兴的吧。

say:18:1041580318:1.text: Tell me more about Whiteridge and this festival! If I ever get a chance, I'd love to drag my family and my best pal over there.
say:18:1041580318:1.source_cn: 能多给我讲讲有关白山公国和冬日祭典的事吗？如果将来有机...
